name: IsBasis.contract_eq_contract_delete
statement: M.IsBasis I X) : M ／ X = M ／ I ＼ (X \ I)

name: IsBasis.contract_isBasis_diff_diff_of_subset
statement: M.IsBasis I X) (hJI : J ⊆ I) : (M ／ J).IsBasis (I \ J) (X \ J)

name: IsBasis.contract_isBasis_of_isBasis'
statement: M.IsBasis I X) (hJC : M.IsBasis' J C) (h_ind : M.Indep (I \ C ∪ J)) : (M ／ C).IsBasis (I \ C) (X \ C)

name: IsBasis.contract_isBasis_of_disjoint
statement: M.IsBasis I X) (hJC : M.IsBasis J C) (hdj : Disjoint C X) (h_ind : M.Indep (I ∪ J)) : (M ／ C).IsBasis I X

name: Spanning.contract
statement: M.Spanning X) (C : Set α) : (M ／ C).Spanning (X \ C)

name: IsCircuit.contract_dep_of_not_subset
statement: M.IsCircuit K) {C : Set α} (hKC : ¬ K ⊆ C) : (M ／ C).Dep (K \ C)

name: IsCircuit.exists_subset_isCircuit_of_contract
statement: (M ／ K).IsCircuit C) : ∃ C', M.IsCircuit C' ∧ C ⊆ C' ∧ C' ⊆ C ∪ K

name: contract_restrict_eq_restrict_contract
statement: Matroid α) (h : Disjoint C R) : (M ／ C) ↾ R = (M ↾ (R ∪ C)) ／ C
